/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

fe = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
sal = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
cc = pd.read_excel('national_programme_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Clean column names
fe.columns = [c.strip() for c in fe.columns]
sal.columns = [c.strip() for c in sal.columns]
cc.columns = [c.strip() for c in cc.columns]

print('FE cols', fe.columns.tolist())
print('SAL cols', sal.columns.tolist())
print('CC cols', cc.columns.tolist())

# Normalize cost centre codes
def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

# Build lookup map
cc['Cost Centre Code_norm'] = cc['Cost Centre Code'].apply(norm)
cc['Programme_norm'] = cc['Programme'].apply(lambda x: str(x).strip().lower() if pd.notna(x) else '')
lookup = {row['Cost Centre Code_norm']: row for _, row in cc.iterrows()}

# Filter Rural Livelihoods codes
target_prog = 'rural livelihoods'
rural_codes = set()
for code_norm, row in lookup.items():
    if row['Programme_norm'] == target_prog:
        rural_codes.add(code_norm)
print('Rural codes count', len(rural_codes))
print(list(rural_codes)[:10])

# Process Field Expenses
fe['Cost Centre_norm'] = fe['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
fe['Posting Status_norm'] = fe['Posting Status'].apply(lambda x: str(x).strip().lower() if pd.notna(x) else '')
fe['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(fe['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
mask_fe = (fe['Posting Status_norm'] == 'posted') & (fe['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(rural_codes))
fe_total = fe.loc[mask_fe, 'Amount (INR)'].sum()
print('Field total', fe_total)

# Process Salary
sal['Cost Centre_norm'] = sal['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
sal['Payroll Status_norm'] = sal['Payroll Status'].apply(lambda x: str(x).strip().lower() if pd.notna(x) else '')
sal['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(sal['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')
mask_sal = (sal['Payroll Status_norm'] == 'paid') & (sal['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(rural_codes))
sal_total = sal.loc[mask_sal, 'Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
print('Salary total', sal_total)

combined = fe_total + sal_total
pct = (sal_total / combined * 100) if combined else 0
print('Combined', combined)
print('Pct', pct)
PY"
